title: 5 Mistakes Plastic Surgeons Make in Marketing - HIP Creative

facts.fact: The HIP Creative article '5 Mistakes Plastic Surgeons Make in Marketing' is dated July 28, 2016.
The article cites a HubSpot blog statistic that 90 percent of customers say video helps them make a purchase decision, a third-party claim the vendor repeats without its own data.
facts.quote: [Ninety percent of customers](http://blog.hubspot.com/marketing/video-marketing-statistics) state that video is helpful to them in making a decision.

facts.fact: The vendor states, without a cited source, that the top three entries on any search results page are paid advertisements, which it says web users increasingly recognize.
facts.quote: they know that the top three entries on any search are paid advertisements
